name: Lightest Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+
subtitle: 100% Mineral Sunscreen | Pregnancy & Lactating Safe
usageInstructions: On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck.

This is the safest shield. Why You’ll Love It: 🚫 Chemical-Free & Gentle – No harsh chemicals, only 100% mineral actives. 💧 Ultra-Light & Non-Greasy – Absorbs fast, no stickiness, no white cast. 🛡️ Pollution + UV Defense – Pollufence™ shields against UV & pollutants. 🌸 Safe for All – Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic & dermatologist-tested. ✅Perfect for sensitive, acne-prone skin ✅Safe for pregnant and lactating women, and kids too

list.title: How to Use Lightest Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ ?
list.content:
Step 1
Apply evenly to face, neck and ears as the final step of your skincare routine, 15 minutes before sun exposure.

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this Lightest Mineral Sunscreen SPF50+ regularly and consistently for 3-4 months.

Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or less if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product,; you can safely use it
Suitable for
• All skin types
Helps
• Protect skin from UVA and UVB rays • Deeply hydrates skin • Improve skin tone • Targets and heals acne • Leaves skin feeling smooth

list.title: Is this suitable for all skin types?
list.content: Since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine.

list.title: Will it leave a white cast?
list.content: Be Bodywise Lightest Mineral Sunscreen has a superlight aqua gel-like texture and doesn't leave a white cast

list.title: How long till I see visible results?
list.content: We recommend using this regularly for 3 months to see visible results.
